name: Vinpearl Safari
summary: Open zoo in Gành Dầu: walk the grounds and ride among the animals from 09:00 to 16:00. The grounds cover nearly 500 ha, with phase 1 at 380 ha, about 3,000 animals of 150 species, and an open zoo of about 40 native species. Above 1.4 m the ticket is 500,000 đồng. Under 1 m is free. The north beach and the safari gate are different stops.
getThere: In Gành Dầu, on the north of the island
heroCaption: Rhinos at the feed shelter in the open ground at Vinpearl Safari
body: Walk the open zoo, then ride the bus through the safari where the animals are outside the vehicle. Công viên Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc is in xã Gành Dầu. It covers nearly 500 ha, of which phase 1 is 380 ha, with about 3,000 animals of 150 species and an open zoo of about 40 native species. It has a veterinary hospital, the largest in Southeast Asia. Hours are 09:00–16:00 every day.

The ticket is free under 1 m, 400,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m and for visitors over 60, and 500,000 đồng above 1.4 m. Read the board at the gate for the day’s window. Gành Dầu beach is the quiet north shore. The safari is the animal park in the same commune.

figures.caption: A rhino on the safari path, with the open ground behind
figures.alt: A white rhino walking beside the road at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc

gettingThere: The safari is in xã Gành Dầu, on the north of the island. Ride north from Dương Đông. The park foothills keep high-rise rooms off Gành Dầu beach. The safari is the animal park in the same commune.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: North to Gành Dầu. The open window is 09:00–16:00 every day. Arrive with enough of that window left for the walk and the bus.

admissionNote: Free under 1 m. 400,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m and for visitors over 60. 500,000 đồng above 1.4 m. Read the board at the gate for the day’s window.
